**Observation Log:**

[FACT] The user is trying to create content that resonates with their audience.

[EVENT] The user is planning to do a Q&A session on IGTV.

[CHANGE] The user decided to use a hybrid approach for the Q&A session, asking followers to submit questions in advance while also allowing for real-time questions and comments.

[TEMPORAL] The user plans to schedule the Q&A session on a Wednesday at 1 pm EST.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant congratulated the user on their increased engagement and new followers.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided tips for maintaining momentum, including consistency, analyzing performance, diversifying content, engaging with the audience, hashtag strategy, collaboration, running contests or giveaways, optimizing the profile, utilizing Instagram's features, and being authentic and patient.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended that for IGTV, the user should focus on long-form content, ensure high-quality production, shoot vertical video, include captions and subtitles, create eye-catching thumbnails, optimize for sound-off viewing, and repurpose IGTV content.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant advised that scheduling the Q&A session during the user's followers' most active period (12 pm - 3 pm EST) would likely increase engagement.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended promoting the Q&A session in advance, using Instagram's features, and creating a branded hashtag to track the conversation.
